description: This file defines the SessionModel class which manages browser session states, including polling session data, handling session actions like close and delete, and notifying listeners of state changes.

classes.name: SessionModel
classes.description: A class that manages browser session states, handles polling, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a listener for session state changes and returns a function to unsubscribe.

methods.name: _notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change.

methods.name: startPolling
methods.description: Begins polling for session data every 3 seconds.

methods.name: sessionByGuid
methods.description: Retrieves a session by its GUID.

methods.name: _fetchSessions
methods.description: Fetches session data from the server and updates internal state.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Public method to trigger fetching session data.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes a session given its descriptor.

methods.name: deleteSessionData
methods.description: Deletes data for a session given its descriptor.
